## Overview

Afnan Javed is a founder based in Pakistan. He has been building projects since 4th grade and works on business problems, product ideas, practical technology solutions, product direction, planning, testing and continuous improvement.

His work includes products of his own and custom digital projects for businesses and organizations. Dinaaro is one of his products, not the full extent of his work.

## Main product: Dinaaro

Website: https://dinaaro.com/
Category: Retail management software
Creator: Afnan Javed

Dinaaro helps retail businesses manage sales, inventory, customer accounts, supplier records, expenses, staff shifts and business reporting through one connected system. It began as software for Afnan's own shop and was shaped through use in daily retail operations.

The product focuses on practical workflows, ease of use and the details business owners need. Its operating experience includes retail environments in Pakistan and Saudi Arabia.

Reported operating milestones:
- More than PKR 1 million in transaction value processed
- Used in 2 retail shops
- More than 1 year of operational experience across Pakistan and Saudi Arabia

These figures describe product operating experience. Transaction value is not revenue. The shop count is not a count of independent SaaS customers.

## Selected client projects

### Oxford Grammar / Cambridge Edtech School
Project: Custom school management system.

The system supports online student attendance, teacher and staff attendance, substitute teacher arrangements, online student records, fee records and vouchers, and student performance records. The school presented Afnan with a certificate in recognition of his work. The exact certificate title and issuing organization should be confirmed before being stated more specifically.

### Switch Power Co.
Project: Business website for an electrical and lighting company in Saudi Arabia.
Website: https://switchpowersa.com/

### Nexus Tech PK
Project: Online storefront for digital products and subscriptions, with custom subscription tracking and customer renewal reminders.
Website: https://nexustech.pk/

## Approach and vision

Afnan is interested in understanding how people work, identifying what can be improved and turning those needs into useful technology. His goal is to help businesses and organizations simplify everyday work, organize information and make better decisions. Retail is one area of work, not a limit on his interests.
